description: This file contains command implementations for managing agent route bindings, including listing, adding, and removing bindings, with functions for resolving agent IDs, handling configuration, and outputting results in JSON or text format.

methods.name: resolveAgentId
methods.description: Resolves an agent ID from input, with optional fallback to default.

methods.name: hasAgent
methods.description: Checks if a given agent ID exists in the configuration.

methods.name: formatBindingOwnerLine
methods.description: Formats a binding owner line for display.

methods.name: resolveTargetAgentIdOrExit
methods.description: Resolves target agent ID or exits if not found.

methods.name: formatBindingConflicts
methods.description: Formats a list of binding conflicts for display.

methods.name: resolveParsedBindingsOrExit
methods.description: Parses binding specifications or exits on error.

methods.name: emitJsonPayload
methods.description: Outputs payload as JSON if requested, and exits on conflict count.

methods.name: resolveConfigAndTargetAgentIdOrExit
methods.description: Resolves configuration and agent ID, or exits if invalid.

methods.name: agentsBindingsCommand
methods.description: Lists current agent route bindings, optionally in JSON.

methods.name: agentsBindCommand
methods.description: Binds agents to routes, updating configuration and outputting results.

methods.name: agentsUnbindCommand
methods.description: Removes agent route bindings, updating configuration and outputting results.
